stories.title: ‘Just a little spark’: disability advocate on inclusion, belonging in Hong Kong

en.title: 'Just a little spark': disability advocate on inclusion, belonging in Hong Kong
en.summary: A disability advocate in Hong Kong notes that while awareness of disability issues has grown, finding employment remains difficult for people with disabilities due to tight corporate budgets and a challenging job market. Employers need to provide proper guidance, workplace accommodations, and roles suited to individual abilities.

stories.title: Hong Kong workers fear AI-driven disruption to retirement but only 20% feel prepared: survey

en.title: Hong Kong workers fear AI-driven disruption to retirement but only 20% feel prepared: survey
en.summary: Over half of Hong Kong workers aged 30 and above believe artificial intelligence will create unpredictability in their retirement prospects compared to previous generations. However, only 20% report feeling financially prepared for this potential disruption.
